Where things stand
I reviewed dump.txt and claude-terminal.txt before writing anything. Two things worth stating up front:

Your tree is green. total: 934, failed: 0, succeeded: 919, skipped: 15, a clean run.sh --smoke, a healthy --containers-only, and scripts/ci_local.sh passing all local gates including the strict Release build. M6 Slice 1 (CI) landed. So the next slice is the one Slice 1's notes promised: the E2E harness plus §16.3 scenarios 1, 13 and 14.

I did not get to writing the files. I spent the budget on verification instead, which — given I can't compile — is where it needed to go. Here's what is now nailed down rather than assumed:

Microsoft.Playwright 1.61.0: ICDPSession.SendAsync(string, Dictionary<string, object>?) → Task<JsonElement?>, IBrowserContext.NewCDPSessionAsync(IPage), ICDPSession : IAsyncDisposable, IPlaywright : IDisposable, Program.Main(string[]) for browser install, and the exact IPage/ILocator/BrowserTypeLaunchOptions/BrowserNewContextOptions members I planned to use. Only PlaywrightException exists as a catchable base — there is no TimeoutException.cs in the tree, so the wait-or-click dance must catch the base type.
Testcontainers.PostgreSql 4.13.0: PostgreSqlBuilder(string image) is the current constructor and the parameterless one is [Obsolete] — which matters, because CI builds with warnings as errors, and your existing PostgreSqlFixture already uses the non-obsolete form. Any new fixture must match it.
CDP WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator needs defaultBackupEligibility/defaultBackupState on modern Chromium (they became required around Chrome 133), so the harness should send them and fall back without them on error.
Design decisions I'd settled on
Child process, not WebApplicationFactory. Program.cs is top-level statements returning int, and Playwright needs a real Kestrel socket. Run the apphost at src/MyRestaurant.WebApplication/bin/{Configuration}/net10.0/MyRestaurant.WebApplication, with ASPNETCORE_CONTENTROOT pointed at the source project dir so UseStaticFiles() finds wwwroot/js/passkey.js.
http://localhost:{port} works despite CookieSecurePolicy.Always — Chromium permits Secure cookies on localhost, and localhost is a secure context for WebAuthn. RESTAURANT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://localhost:{port} satisfies Validate() and WebAuthnOriginPolicy trusts the loopback origin.
One fresh database and one app process per scenario on a shared container, so no test ordering dependency (scenario 1 needs zero administrators; 13 needs the admin it creates).
No server clock control needed for scenario 14. Insert a table with a known 32-byte secret via SQL, set TABLE_JOIN_TOKEN_ROTATION_SECONDS=3600, and compute window−4 and window−1 tokens with the real JoinTokenService. Anonymous: expired → friendly page, previous window → redirect to /sign-in?ReturnUrl=…. That's cheaper and more deterministic than a fake clock.
Opt-in gate (MYRESTAURANT_E2E=1) so dotnet test stays at 934/919/15 and nobody downloads 150 MB of Chromium by surprise, with a new end-to-end CI job and a --with-e2e flag on ci_local.sh.
Files the slice touches: the E2E .csproj (add Npgsql, Testcontainers.PostgreSql, a MyRestaurant.Domain reference and a build-order-only reference to the web app), six new harness files, a rewritten EndToEndScenarios.cs, ci.yml, ci_local.sh, README.md, docs/_append/BUILD_PROGRESS-m6-slice-2.md, _CHANGES.md. No deletions, no migration, no Directory.Packages.props change — both new packages are already pinned centrally.

Say "continue" and I'll write the full files and the tarball in the next turn — the research is done, so it's straight to output.

M6 Slice 2 — the end-to-end harness, and §16.3 scenarios 1, 13, 14
bash
tar -xzf m6-slice2-end-to-end-harness.tar.gz -C /home/kushal/src/dotnet/myrestaurant
Files to delete: none. No migration, no schema change, no Directory.Packages.props edit, nothing in src/ touched. git status should show exactly these 13 paths.

New (7)
Six under tests/MyRestaurant.EndToEnd.Tests/Harness/ — RestaurantHarness.cs (class fixture: opt-in gate, Chromium, shared PostgreSQL container), RestaurantInstance.cs (per-scenario database + app process + browser context, with the app's stdout/stderr captured into failure messages), VirtualAuthenticator.cs, AccountJourneys.cs (the /setup wizard, sign-out, passkey sign-in), WebApplicationLocator.cs, ContainerEngineDiscovery.cs — plus docs/_append/BUILD_PROGRESS-m6-slice-2.md.

Edited (6)
EndToEndScenarios.cs, the E2E .csproj, .github/workflows/ci.yml (fourth gate: end-to-end), scripts/ci_local.sh (--with-e2e, --with-all), README.md, _CHANGES.md.

Three things worth knowing before you run it
The origin trick is load-bearing. Served at http://localhost:{port}, configured as https://localhost:{port}. §13 refuses a non-https public origin; Chromium treats localhost as a secure context regardless of scheme, so WebAuthn runs and the Secure §3.1 cookie is accepted; only the host is ever compared, so the RP ID comes out localhost at both registration and sign-in. None of that holds for an IP address.

Scenario 14 needs no clock control. JoinTokenService is pure, so the harness computes tokens for window − 4 and window − 1 from a secret it chose. TABLE_JOIN_TOKEN_ROTATION_SECONDS is per-instance, defaulting to 3600, purely to make the boundary race impossible — §4.3 accepts current-or-previous at any width. Scenario 2 will ask the same knob for a short window.

Opt-in. MYRESTAURANT_E2E=1. The first run downloads ~150 MB of Chromium, and the rest of your suite is offline once restored. The coverage lives in CI's new job, not behind the switch.

Checklist
dotnet restore — two new package references, no new versions.
dotnet build.
dotnet test — still 934 / 919 / 15. Three facts moved from a discovery-time skip to a runtime one; the summary counts that identically. If the total moved, something else moved with it.
MYRESTAURANT_E2E=1 dotnet test tests/MyRestaurant.EndToEnd.Tests — the real check. Expect 3 passed, 12 skipped. If Chromium complains about shared libraries: pwsh tests/MyRestaurant.EndToEnd.Tests/bin/Debug/net10.0/playwright.ps1 install --with-deps chromium once.
bash scripts/ci_local.sh --with-e2e.
bash -n clean as delivered; the YAML parses (four jobs); every *.cs is file-scoped, brace-balanced, LF, no tabs. Where to look if a step breaks is in the BUILD_PROGRESS append — six numbered candidates, and the harness names the exact path or config error in its own message for the first four.
